name: Ultra Ball
effect: -5 from your capture roll.

name: Master Ball

name: Park Ball
effect: -20 from your capture roll against domesticated wild Pokemon; otherwise, +5 to your capture roll. Often used in capture contests or on wild reserves.

name: Safari Ball
effect: -20 from your capture roll against domesticated wild Pokemon; otherwise, +5 to your capture roll. Often used in capture contests or on wild reserves.

name: Sport Ball
effect: -20 from your capture roll against domesticated wild Pokemon; otherwise, +5 to your capture roll. Often used in capture contests or on wild reserves.

name: Cherish Ball
effect: -5 from your capture roll. Captured Pokemon are more easily befriended.

name: Luxury Ball
effect: -5 from your capture roll. Captured Pokemon are more easily befriended.

name: Premier Ball

name: Dive Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -12 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon is in water.

name: Dusk Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -7 from your capture roll instead if it's night time (no sunlight).

name: Fast Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -8 from your capture roll instead on a Pokemon that acts before your Pokemon.

name: Lure Ball

name: Quick Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -16 from your capture roll instead if thrown as your first action during combat.

name: Repeat Ball

name: Timer Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -10 from your capture roll instead if the encounter has lasted at least one minute, or -18 from your capture roll if the encounter has lasted at least two minutes.

name: Friend Ball
effect: +0 to your capture roll. Captured Pokemon are more easily befriended.

name: Heal Ball
effect: +0 to your capture roll. Captured Pokemon are healed 20 hit points.

name: Dream Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -10 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon is afflicted.

name: Heavy Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -15 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon is Heavy or Superweight.

name: Level Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -10 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon is fully evolved, and did evolve at least once.

name: Love Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -10 from your capture roll instead if the target shares a type with one of your active Pokemon.

name: Moon Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -10 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon evolves with an evolution stone.

name: Nest Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -10 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon can evolve, but is not evolved.

name: Net Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -15 from your capture roll instead when used against a Bug or Water type Pokemon.

name: Beast Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -25 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon is from a parallel dimension. Rarely works well outside that circumstance.

name: Strange Ball
effect: +10 to your capture roll normally; -25 from your capture roll instead if the Pokemon is temporally displaced. Rarely works well outside that circumstance.

name: TM (At-Will)
effect: Teaches an at-will frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Can be used up to 3 times before its data corrupts. Price is approximate.

name: TM (3/day)
effect: Teaches a 3/day frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Can be used up to 3 times before its data corrupts. Price is approximate.

name: TM (1/day)
effect: Teaches a 1/day frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Can be used up to 3 times before its data corrupts. Price is approximate.

name: TR (At-Will)
effect: Technical Record. Teaches an at-will frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Rendered useless after 1 use. Price is approximate.

name: TR (3/day)
effect: Technical Record. Teaches a 3/day frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Rendered useless after 1 use. Price is approximate.

name: TR (1/day)
effect: Technical Record. Teaches a 1/day frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Rendered useless after 1 use. Price is approximate.

name: HM (At-Will)
effect: Teaches an at-will frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Exceedingly rare; never runs out of uses no matter how many times it is used.

name: HM (3/day)
effect: Teaches a 3/day frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Exceedingly rare; never runs out of uses no matter how many times it is used.

name: HM (1/day)
effect: Teaches a 1/day frequency move to a compatible Pokemon at a Pokemon Center's teaching device. Exceedingly rare; never runs out of uses no matter how many times it is used.

name: Basic Tool Kit
effect: Basic tools for basic repairs or maintenance. Includes hammer, screwdriver (adaptable head), wrench, handsaw, steel ruler, level, nails (40 assorted), screws (40 assorted), nuts and bolts (40 assorted), and a tackle box they fit snugly in with little room for anything else.

name: Camera Bag
effect: Everything you need as a traveling photographer, minus the camera. Includes lenses (3), extra bulbs (2), gaffer tape, microfiber cloth, micro screw driver, micro flash light, extra battery (1), extra memory card (20 GB), ear plugs, and the bag which has room for your camera (camera not included).

name: Cooking Kit
effect: For the chef on the go, in the wilds. Includes portable electric stove (2 burners), cast iron pan, cast iron pot with lid, water purifier, cutting board, cutting knife, measuring cups and spoons, spatula, cooking spoon, and a sturdy bag it all fits into. The electric stove can be charged to use for two weeks after a 4-hour charge.

name: Dig Kit
effect: Whatever you're looking for, this should help. Includes extendable shovel, extendable pickaxe, hammer, trowel, compass, measuring tape (25ft), 6 in. stakes (10), string (600 ft), and a tool roll bag with some room for more equipment.

name: Drawing Kit
effect: For an artist, or maybe just a doodler. Includes drawing pad (200pp), journal (200pp), blue pencils (10), mechanical pencils (2), kneaded eraser, white vinyl eraser, blender, pen and ink, assorted brush pens (10), and a bag with extra room to carry it all.

name: Studious Pack
effect: Useful things for a trainer with a knack for academics. Includes solar charger, universal power adapter, universal adapter dongle, memory stick (40 GB), binder, folders (6), notebooks (3), journal, notepad, pencils (5), pens (3), highlighter, vinyl eraser, pencil sharpener, ruler, headphones, water bottle, and a backpack or side pack to fit everything with extra room for a laptop (laptop not included).

name: Traveler's Pack
effect: Really useful gear for extended travel through the wilds. Includes collapsible pop-up tent (two-person 7x4 ft), tarp (8x10 ft), sleeping bag, pocket knife, solar flashlight, compass, waterproof matches (20), water bottle, and a compression sack with straps to snugly fit everything.

name: Trainer's Pack
effect: Basic goods for a trainer who's starting their journey. Includes solar charger, universal power adapter, compression bands (4), crepe bandages (4), micro screwdriver, water bottle, and a backpack or side pack to fit everything with a great deal of extra room.

name: Engineer's Tool Kit
effect: If you're building something on the go, or taking something else apart. Includes electric unfolding soldering table (2x2 ft), soldering iron, desoldering pump, assorted soldering iron tips (8), soldering assist tools (2), tin wire tube, tweezers, wire stripper cutter, electric wire (80 ft), long nose pliers (2), precision screwdriver, magnetic/gripping retrieving tool, telescoping mirror, various spare screws (100). The table folds into itself while storing all of the supplies, revealing a handle.

name: Field Survey Kit
effect: For trainers who want to do research while out in the wilds. Includes track molds, casting plaster, sample vials (10), scent tags (6), UV flashlight, measuring calipers, field notebook, and a weatherproof case.

name: Fishing Kit
effect: For trainers who are looking to lure underwater Pokemon to the surface. Includes telescoping fishing rod, spare reel lines (2), assorted hooks (100), assorted bobbers (10), sinkers (10), assorted lures (10), needle nose pliers, small knife, and a tackle box with room to store a bit more.

name: Grooming Kit
effect: Your Pokemon will always look their best when you're using this kit. Includes electronic trimmer, trimmer length attachments (8), assorted combs (5), assorted brushes (5), assorted scissors/shears (3), clippers, nail file, soap (8 oz.), shampoo (8 oz.), and bag with room for more. The trimmer can be charged to use for one week after a 1-hour charge.

name: Make Up Kit
effect: You will always look your best with this kit. Includes moisturizer, primers, concealers, foundation, assorted blush, assorted bronzer/highlighter, powders, setting spray, eyeliner pencil, liquid eyeliner, assorted mascara, lash curler, assorted lip balm, assorted lipstick, assorted lip gloss, and a collapsing case with room to expand your options.

name: Medical Field Kit
effect: Includes pain relievers (20 pills), antihistamine (20 pills), cold/flu relievers (20 pills), electrolyte tablets (20 pills), antiseptic solution (8oz.), antiseptic gel (8 oz.), medical adhesive tape (30ft), slings (2), crepe bandages (2 3ft. rolls), cloth bandages (4 3ft. rolls), gauze swabs (30), stitch strips (20), ear plugs (10), safety pins (20), thermometer, small scissors, small scalpel, tweezers, and assorted adhesive bandages (40), and a folding carrying case. Useful for keeping trainers from dying, but less useful with Pokemon unless proficient in its use. As an action, attempt a Medicine skill check of 15 to stabilize an unconscious trainer to 1 hit point (or spend 5 minutes out of combat for the same effect). Out of combat, you may attempt a Medicine skill check of 15 once per hour to cure a target of any affliction.

name: Mess Kit
effect: Everything you need to enjoy a meal on the go. Includes a plate, a bowl, a fork, a spoon, a knife, a cup, and a slip it all fits into neatly.

name: Miscreant's Pack
effect: There's no real reason to have this, let alone sell it; not easily found in stores. Includes solar charger, universal power adapter, universal adapter dongle, memory sticks (4 80 GB), micro file (2), lock picks (8), multi-head screwdriver, hammer, crowbar, small narrow saw, small narrow scissors, telescoping mirror, thin wire (20 ft), water bottle, and a backpack or side pack to fit everything with some extra room.

name: Performer's Pack
effect: Perfect for trainers who travel as entertainers, coordinators, or influencers. Includes portable sound amplifier, collapsible microphone stand, handheld microphone, lighting orb (soft adjustable illumination), styling kit (hair ties, pins, compact mirror), autograph pens (5), poster tube, and a reinforced carry pack with segmented storage.

name: Poke Ball Smith Kit
effect: If you're planning to make your own Poke Balls, this will be necessary. Includes electric unfolding soldering table (2x2 ft), soldering iron, desoldering pump, assorted soldering iron tips (8), tin wire tube, tweezers, wire stripper cutter, electric wire (80 ft), micro screwdriver, micro screws (400), micro glass and mirror spares (200), micro rods (200), micro steel sheets (200). The table folds into itself while storing all of the supplies, revealing a handle.

name: Portable Chemistry Set
effect: Science on the go! Includes portable Bunsen burner, beakers (1 250 ml/1 50 ml), conical flask (100 ml), measuring cylinder (25ml), test tubes (6 10 ml), reusable spray bottles (6), test tube rack, heat clamps, thermometer, glass dropper, stirring rod, cleaning brush, corks (12), mortar and pestle, spatula, and a padded case. The reusable bottles can store concoctions to be reused once cleaned.

name: Ruin Explorer's Pack
effect: Intended for trainers investigating ancient sites, abandoned structures, and lost routes. Includes artifact brushes (3), chisels (2), small pry bar, UV lamp, translation rubbing kit (paper sheets 50, charcoal sticks 6), clay impression tools, measuring calipers, sealing wax and tubes for fragment storage, protective gloves, and a padded backpack with reinforced compartments and limited extra room.

name: Sewing Kit
effect: This is useful for the designer on the go. Includes electronic folding sewing machine, measuring tape (6ft), assorted buttons and fasteners (50), assorted spools of thread (20), hand-sewing needles (10), fabric pens (10), bleach pen, stain removing pen, pins (50), needle threader, pincushion, fabric shears, seam ripper, thimbles. The sewing machine folds into itself while storing all of the supplies, revealing a handle, and can be charged to use for two weeks after a 4-hour charge.

name: Spiritualist's Pack
effect: For those who travel and spread the word of various greater beings. Includes solar charger, universal power adapter, religious texts (2), religious symbol, candles (10), incense sticks (20), waterproof matches (25), water bottle, and a backpack or side pack to fit everything with a great deal of extra room.

name: Arctic Travel Pack
effect: For exposure to cold climates and snow-covered routes. Includes thermal cloak, insulated boots, snow goggles, chemical heat packs (10), collapsible snow shovel, insulated water flask, and a compression pack rated for sub-zero conditions.

name: Climber's Pack
effect: For steep routes, cliffs, and elevated terrain. Includes climbing rope (200 ft), pitons (12), hammer, climbing harness, locking carabiners (6), chalk pouch, protective gloves, and a compression pack with external loops for securing rope.

name: Coastal & Open Water Pack
effect: For long island routes, shoreline travel, and open-water crossings. Includes flotation vest, dry bags (3), rope (75 ft), signal whistle, saltwater filter attachment, collapsible paddle, and a waterproof backpack with sealed zippers.

name: Extreme Weather Pack
effect: For routes with dangerous or unpredictable weather conditions. Includes insulated cloak (reversible heat-reflective lining), weatherproof poncho, protective goggles (ash/sand/snow), breathing scarf with replaceable filter, emergency thermal blanket, signal flare (2), and a reinforced pack with sealed seams and minimal extra space.

name: Swamp & Wetlands Pack
effect: Built for travel through marshes, bogs, and flooded wilds. Includes waterproof thigh-high boots, collapsible walking pole, waterproof map case, rope (50 ft), and a sealed carrying bag with drainage grommets.

name: Volcanic Route Pack
effect: Intended for travel near active volcanic zones and other dangerous extreme heat environments. Includes heat-resistant cloak, fireproof tarp (6x8 ft), insulated gloves, respirator mask, cooling gel packs (4), emergency water ration (2 liters), and a reinforced pack with heat-shielded lining.

name: Egg Incubator
effect: Electronic, reusable container that safely keeps and warms a Pokemon egg. Once charged over 4 hours, it lasts for weeks to keep the egg safe and warm for healthy hatching. Can be dropped from up to 100 ft or submerged in water without harming the egg.

name: Folding Bicycle
effect: A 3-speed bike that folds onto itself. Wheels are 26 in.; unfolded frame length and height are 48x40 in.; has telescoping handles and seats adjustable for any rider's height.

name: Lure Module Launcher
effect: An electronic setup that deploys scent/light emitters lasting 30 minutes that attract Pokemon to your location in wild spaces. Emitter reloads cost 150 each, and cost more for specialized Type-attracting emitters.

name: Portable Berry Planter
effect: Creates a mini-ecosystem for a planted berry to rapidly grow into a fruit-bearing shrub, often producing two or three berries. When planting, roll a Nature skill check; then roll a Nature skill check once per day over the next five days while watering. If you ever roll under 6, the shrub yields 1 berry when it fruits. If you roll over 5 each time, the shrub yields 2 berries. If you ever roll over 20 without rolling under 6, the shrub yields 3 berries. Failing to water the shrub at least once per day, or harvesting its berries, kills the shrub.

name: Signal Scanner
effect: Handheld device that detects nearby electronic signals (50ft), recent Poke Ball activity (2 minutes), and strong energy emissions nearby (150ft). Holds a charge for 6 hours of use; charges in 30 minutes.

name: Solar Charger
effect: An unfolding solar panel that charges devices such as phones, computers, or other portable items when left open in the sun. Does not hold a charge itself, only charging other things.

name: Blizzard Wear
effect: Carefully made clothes for humans. While worn, human trainers do not take damage from Hailing Weather, whether made by Pokemon or naturally occurring.

name: Desert Gear
effect: Carefully made clothes for humans. While worn, human trainers do not take damage from Sandstorming Weather, whether made by Pokemon or naturally occurring.

name: Diving Gear
effect: Self-contained underwater breathing apparatus. Allows humans to explore underwater with enough air to breathe for two hours. The tank can be refilled above water with a solar-powered tank in two hours.

name: Hazmat Suit
effect: Full-body protective suit that shields trainers from dangerous chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear harms. While worn, human trainers will not suffer damage or penalties during long-term exposure.

name: Wet Suit
effect: Insulated body suit for diving in any waters, including gloves and flippers. While worn, human trainers will not suffer damage even in arctic temperatures.
